name: Hold My Draft
description: Lets editors "hold" the latest revision (draft) and block further editing until released.
project_description:
This module allows for simple maneuvering between a published revision and forward unpublished revisions. With core revisions, you cannot easily edit a published revision state without losing work or publishing work in progress.

 The common use case:

 Published revision

Many forward drafts with a new page section being written. Waiting on approval.

 And then... a typo is discovered on the published page! What is a content editor to do? Hold my draft... 

 With Hold my Draft they can: 

 
 "pause" work on the forward drafts 
 make the needed edits to the published revision 
 restore the drafts to the top of the revisions list 
 ...and resume editing! 
 
 A draft-hold is initiated from the revisions tab. 

 Includes separate permissions for starting and completing draft-holds. Requires core content moderation module.
